finding.claim: SearchSheet panics on ordinary search text because regexp.MustCompile(value) runs unconditionally, even in plain-text mode.
finding.source: value argument of SearchSheet (sheet.go:1098), e.g. user-typed search text; reg omitted/false
finding.sink: regexp.MustCompile(value) at sheet.go:1133 (panics on invalid RE2 such as 'C++', '(', '[', '*x')

trace.note: MustCompile on raw value before regSearch branch; panic
plain mode compares val != value; regex compile was unnecessary

finding.guards_checked: No recover() in non-test code; no validation of value before compile; plain mode does not use the compiled regex.

finding.claim: Malformed OLE-wrapped workbook input causes unrecovered slice-bounds panics in the standard and agile decryptors, reachable without a password.
finding.source: Bytes of any file with OLE magic (excelize.go:208-214 calls Decrypt regardless of Password option); attacker controls EncryptionInfo/EncryptedPackage stream contents and header fields (KeySize, encryptionHeaderSize, keyBits)
finding.sink: Slice expressions: crypt.go:244 encryptionInfoBuf[8:12]; 245/257 block slices from attacker encryptionHeaderSize; 274 encryptedPackageBuf[8:] (nil when stream missing); 281-283 x[bs:be] when len not multiple of 16; 327 x3[:KeySize/8]; agile 470 key[:KeyBits/8] with negative keyBits

trace.note: Decrypt called with untrusted bytes, no password required
loop slices beyond len(x) for non-16-aligned input
key slice may exceed 40-byte derived buffer

finding.guards_checked: extractPart caps stream size at input length (crypt.go:202-204), which bounds allocation but not slicing; no recover(); no length validation of header fields.

finding.claim: Non-worksheet zip parts are fully materialized in memory, preallocated to the declared size, with a default per-archive limit of 16 GB, enabling large memory amplification from a small DEFLATE bomb.
finding.source: Zip central-directory declared sizes and compressed stream of any non-worksheet/non-sharedStrings entry in an untrusted workbook passed to OpenReader/OpenFile
finding.sink: make([]byte, 0, declared size) at lib.go:162 and unbounded io.Copy into memory at lib.go:164 (via readFile called at lib.go:86)

trace.note: non-XML part read fully into memory
io.Copy fills up to declared size

finding.guards_checked: checkFileSize (lib.go:33-41) cumulative vs UnzipSizeLimit; worksheet and sharedStrings over UnzipXMLSizeLimit offloaded to temp file (lib.go:65-84); archive/zip caps output at declared size. Gap: other parts always in RAM up to 16 GB.

finding.claim: Formula evaluation recurses without a depth limit along acyclic reference chains, so a long chain can exhaust the Go stack, which is a fatal non-recoverable runtime error.
finding.source: Formulas in an untrusted workbook evaluated via CalcCellValue (calc.go:878) or UpdateLinkedValue (excelize.go:531)
finding.sink: Recursive call calcCellValue -> cellResolver -> calcCellValue at calc.go:1827 with no depth bound (stack overflow)
finding.guards_checked: Cycle protection via ctx.entry and iterations/MaxCalcIterations (calc.go:1821-1833) only bounds cycles; no depth or stack limit found anywhere in non-test code. Not executed; threshold unknown.

finding.claim: Agile spin count up to 1e7 lets a crafted file cost seconds of CPU per open attempt.
finding.source: spinCount attribute in EncryptionInfo XML of an untrusted OLE-wrapped workbook
finding.sink: Iterative hashing loop at crypt.go:458-461 bounded only by maxSpinCount = 1e7
finding.guards_checked: Range check against maxSpinCount (crypt.go:440-443). Upper bound is high relative to Office default of 100000. Severity low.

finding.claim: Standard-encryption decryption never verifies the password against the encrypted verifier, so wrong passwords are detected only indirectly when zip parsing fails.
finding.source: Password supplied through Options, and the EncryptionInfo verifier bytes from the file
finding.sink: Key derivation output used directly to decrypt the package without comparing the decrypted verifier hash

trace.note: decrypt with derived key without verifier check
zip failure mapped to ErrWorkbookPassword only when a password was set

finding.guards_checked: Indirect detection through zip parse failure only. Low severity, logic gap.

finding.claim: Duplicate zip entry names overwrite tempFiles entries, leaking earlier temp files on disk, and unzipToTemp leaks file descriptors on error paths.
finding.source: Zip entries with duplicate worksheet or sharedStrings names in an untrusted workbook
finding.sink: f.tempFiles.Store overwrite at lib.go:68 and 79; unzipToTemp returns without closing tmp or rc at lib.go:95-111

trace.note: Store overwrites prior temp path for same name
io.Copy error returns without closing tmp/rc

finding.guards_checked: UnzipSizeLimit bounds total bytes written. Impact limited to leftover temp files and open descriptors until process exit. Low severity.
